title: 云计算和SaaS产业结构性变化信号
core_insight: 云计算和SaaS领域主要变化信号来自于云厂商的技术和基础设施更新，以及AI和数据分析的融合进展

dimension_texts.infrastructure: AWS推出了新一代EC2实例，采用NVIDIA RTX PRO 4500 Blackwell Server Edition GPU Microsoft和Chevron计划在美国建设一个大型的天然气动力数据中心 Announcing Amazon EC2 G7 instances accelerated by NVIDIA RTX PRO 4500 Blackwell Server Edition GPUs Microsoft and Chevron plan one of the largest gas-powered data center projects in US
dimension_texts.application: Salesforce推出了Headless 360，提供了AI原生的架构，HubSpot的answer engine优化工具进入了新的市场 AWS推出了多项新服务，包括AWS Lambda MicroVMs和Amazon EC2 G7实例 How to Design an AI-Native Architecture with Salesforce Headless 360 Run isolated sandboxes with full lifecycle control: AWS Lambda introduces MicroVMs How to rank in AI search results: Expert best practices
